detail.longDescription: OptFOREST: OptGERM: a new open database on how young trees respond to a warming climate. “A new study presents OptGERM, an open database developed within OptFORESTS that follows 15,774 seeds from six European tree species to help understand how the earliest life stages of trees respond to warming.” https://rbfirehose.com/2026/11/02/optgerm-a-new-open-database-on-how-young-trees-respond-to-a-warming-climate-optforest/
